About UsDe Pijp Boutique Hotel is a premium, intimate design hotel located in the heart of Amsterdam's most vibrant neighborhood. Because we are a small boutique property with a close-knit team, our night staff plays a crucial role in maintaining high-end guest satisfaction, safety, and operational excellence while the city sleeps.We are looking for a reliable, responsible, and proactive Part-Time Night Receptionist who takes pride in absolute ownership of the property during the night.Position SummaryAs our Night Receptionist, you are the sole guardian of the hotel during the late-night and early-morning hours (typically from 00:00 to 08:00).
